'''Maggot''' is a small {{type|Worm}} [[enemy]] found in several areas, and can be summoned through multiple ability and item effects.

== Behavior ==
Melee attacker, will move towards its enemies, and ignore traps and hazardus tiles. 

Uses {{a|Melee Attack}} as its [[Basic Attack]].

If a maggot is affected by {{el|Mutate}}, it will mutate into either a {{en|Chargey Maggot}}, {{en|Burfer Maggot}}, or {{en|Diggy Maggot}}.

=== Tips ===
* Placing {{tile|Bramble|Bramble Tiles}} and similar Tiles in their path will kill them without needs to use an action.
* As familiars, they can be useful to trigger effects that require killing units, like {{a|Soul Reap}} and {{p|Hunter's Boon}}.

== Notes ==
* Does not leave a corpse.
* {{en|Leech}} (and all other leech varieties) are considered a variant of Maggot and will similarly evolve with radiation.
* {{a|Butt Scoot}}, {{a|Spawn Maggot Friend}} and {{i|Bag Of Chum}} summon a green maggot familiar that is identical to the enemy variant in all but color.

== Trivia ==
* Maggots have a similar appearance to the [[tboi:Flat_Worm|Worm Trinkets]] found in The Binding of Isaac.
* Despite being the larval form of {{en|Fly|Flies}}, Maggots aren't able to be spawned by them in any way, and don't have the same types.
